analyzed: tatas brahmaṇaḥ koṇa sūtrasya ca bahis sūtrāt bahis dvi mātrikam antaram tyaktvā prathamam sūtram brahmaṇaḥ koṇa sūtrasya ca tad pārśva sūtrayoḥ ca upari dvāra mānam

original: tiryak pārśvayor dvidvimātrikatvāt / tasya bahis tathā pañcasūtrāṇi / koṇatatpārśvasūtropari ṣaṣṭham api sūtraṃ /
analyzed: tiryak pārśvayoḥ dvi dvi mātrika tvāt tasya bahis tathā pañca sūtrāṇi koṇa tad pārśva sūtra upari ṣaṣṭham api sūtram

original: tatra brahmaṇo dakṣiṇe prathamasyaikamātrāntān niḥsṛtya dvitīyasyāgre gatvā tṛtīyasyaikamātrānte praviśya caturthasyāgre gatvā pañcamasyaikamātrānte praviśya ṣaṣṭhasyāgre gatvā saptamāsyaikamātrānte praviṣṭaṃ sūtraṃ vakram ekaṃ bhavati / asyābhyantare 'rdhamātrāntaraṃ hitvā sūtram idam iva vakraṃ dvitīyaṃ /
analyzed: tatra brahmaṇaḥ dakṣiṇe prathamasya eka mātrā antāt niḥsṛtya dvitīyasya agre gatvā tṛtīyasya eka mātrā ante praviśya caturthasya agre gatvā pañcamasya eka mātrā ante praviśya ṣaṣṭhasya agre gatvā saptama asya eka mātrā ante praviṣṭam sūtram vakram ekam bhavati asya abhyantare rdha mātrā antaram hitvā sūtram idam iva vakram dvitīyam

original: evaṃ vakrasūtradvayaṃ brahmaṇo vāme 'pi tathā koṇasūtrasya vāmetarayoḥ /
analyzed: evam vakra sūtra dvayam brahmaṇaḥ vāme tathā koṇa sūtrasya vāma itarayoḥ

original: tato nābhau sūtraṃ dhṛtvā mūlasūtram ādāyābhyantare / ekaikadvārāntareṇa brahmaṇidhṛtasūtreṇa catvāri vṛttasūtrāṇi / yad uktaṃ /
analyzed: tatas nābhau sūtram dhṛtvā mūla sūtram ādāya abhyantare ekaika dvāra antareṇa brahmaṇi dhṛta sūtreṇa catvāri vṛtta sūtrāṇi yat uktam

original: mūlasūtram upādāya vṛttaṃ sūtracatuṣṭayaṃ //
analyzed: mūlasūtram upādāya vṛttam sūtra catuṣṭayam

original: bhrāmayitvā tricakrāṇāṃ dvāramānena saṃgataṃ //
analyzed: bhrāmayitvā tri cakrāṇām dvāra mānena saṃgatam

original: śeṣam aṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ mānaṃ nāto 'dhikaṃ manāk //
analyzed: śeṣam aṣṭadalam padmam mānam na atas dhikam manāk

original: vajrapadmārimālāś ca cittacakrādinemiṣu //
analyzed: vajra padma ari mālāḥ ca citta cakra ādi nemiṣu

original: iti /
analyzed: iti

original: tatrādyatrayāṇāṃ pratyekam abhyantare 'rdhamātrāntareṇa vṛttasūtram ekaṃ / caturthasya tu cittacakranābhyantasūcakasyābhyantare mātrikāpādāṃśāt paradalasārdhadvimātrikāntareṇa karṇikārthaṃ vṛttasūtram ekaṃ keśaravalayarūpaṃ /
analyzed: tatra ādya trayāṇām pratyekam abhyantare rdha mātrā antareṇa vṛtta sūtram ekam caturthasya tu cittacakra nābhi anta sūcakasya abhyantare mātrikā pāda aṃśāt para dala sārdha dvi mātrikā antareṇa karṇikā artham vṛtta sūtram ekam keśara valaya rūpam

original: caturthasyāpy abhyantare vajrāvalīvalayārtham ardhamātrāntareṇa vṛttasūtram ekam ity apy kaścit uktaṃ / vajraiś caturbhir atyugrair veṣṭayed arapārśvayor ity anyaḥ / arapārśvopari yathāyogaṃ vajrapadmacakramālā ity aparaḥ /
analyzed: caturthasya api abhyantare vajra āvalī valaya artham ardha mātrā antareṇa vṛtta sūtram ekam iti api kaścid uktam vajraiḥ caturbhiḥ ati ugraiḥ veṣṭayet ara pārśvayoḥ iti anyaḥ ara pārśva upari yathāyogam vajra padma cakra mālāḥ iti aparaḥ

original: atra bahirvṛttasūtrābhyantare vṛttasūtrāṇy ārāsūtrāṇi ca saṃrakṣyānyāni proñched iti viśeṣā ṭṭippanī /
analyzed: atra bahis vṛtta sūtra abhyantare vṛtta sūtrāṇi ārā sūtrāṇi ca saṃrakṣya anyāni proñchet iti viśeṣā ṭṭippanī

original: 12.5.13 Buddhakapālamaṇḍala (p.197)
analyzed: R Buddha kapāla maṇḍala

original: iyam eva pañcaviṃśatyātmakasya buddhakapālasya maṇḍale viśeṣas tu prathamoktacaturthavṛttasūtraṃ keśarasūtraṃ ca na kartavyaṃ / ṣaṣṭhavṛttasūtrābhyantare hi dalapañcamātrikāntareṇa vṛttasūtram ekaṃ keśararūpam atreti /
analyzed: iyam eva pañcaviṃśati ātmakasya buddha kapālasya maṇḍale viśeṣaḥ tu prathama ukta caturtha vṛtta sūtram keśara sūtram ca na kartavyam ṣaṣṭha vṛtta sūtra abhyantare hi dala pañca mātrikā antareṇa vṛtta sūtram ekam keśara rūpam atra iti

original: 12.5.14 Yogāmbaramaṇḍala (p.197)
analyzed: R 12514 Cp ambara maṇḍala

original: yogāmbaramaṇḍale mūlasūtrābhyantare sārdhatrimātrikāntaraṃ hitvā mātrikāntaraṃ vṛttasūtradvayamadhyagavajrāvalyāḥ / tataḥ sārdhatrimātrikāntareṇa vṛttam aparā tu ṭipiḥ piṇḍīkramoktamaṇḍala iva / mūlasūtrābhyantare kūṭāgāradvayaṃ ṭipiś ca vakṣyamāṇatricatvāriṃśadātmakamañjuvajramaṇḍalavad ity anyaḥ /
analyzed: yoga ambara maṇḍale mūla sūtra abhyantare sārdha tri mātrikā antaram hitvā mātrikā antaram vṛtta sūtra dvaya madhya ga vajrāvalyāḥ tatas sārdha tri mātrikā antareṇa vṛttam aparā tu ṭipiḥ piṇḍī krama ukta maṇḍale iva mūla sūtra abhyantare kūṭāgāra dvayam ṭipiḥ ca vakṣyamāṇa tricatvāriṃśat ātmaka mañju vajra maṇḍala vat iti anyaḥ

original: garbhakūṭāgārād dvitīyaṃ kūṭāgāraṃ vṛttam iti kaścit / na kūṭāgāram atra.
analyzed: garbhakūṭāgārāt dvitīyam kūṭāgāram vṛttam iti kaścid na kūṭāgāram atra

original: vajrāvalī prāgvad ity aparaḥ /
analyzed: vajra āvalī prāgvat iti aparaḥ

original: 12.5.15 Yamārimaṇḍala (p.198)
analyzed: R 12515 Cp ari maṇḍala

original: śrīmadyamāres trayodaśātmakasya maṇḍale brahmakoṇasūtrāṇy eva nānyat / tatra brahmasūtrād dvāradvayāntaraṃ tyaktvā viśvavajravedīsūtram ekaṃ tiryak koṇasūtraṃ yāvat / tasyābhyantare vajrāvalīsūtram ekaṃ mātrikāntaraṃ tyaktvā vedīsūtrād dvāraṃ yāvat pañcārāṇi / tadanu brahmakoṇasūtrāṇi lopayed iti viśeṣā ṭippitaṃ /
analyzed: śrīmat yamāreḥ trayodaśa ātmakasya maṇḍale brahmakoṇa sūtrāṇi eva na anyat tatra brahmasūtrāt dvāra dvaya antaram tyaktvā viśva vajra vedī sūtram ekam tiryak koṇa sūtram yāvat tasya abhyantare vajra āvalī sūtram ekam mātrikā antaram tyaktvā vedī sūtrāt dvāram yāvat tadanu brahmakoṇa sūtrāṇi lopayet iti viśeṣāḥ ṭippitam

original: 12.5.16 Vajratārāmaṇḍala (p.199)
analyzed: R vajra tārā maṇḍala

original: vajratārāyā maṇḍale brahmakoṇasūtreṣv eva sthiteṣu brahmato bahiḥ karṇikātrimātrāntareṇa vṛttaṃ sūtram ekaṃ tadbahir dalaṣaṇmātrāntareṇa vṛttasūtraṃ brahmakoṇasūtrāṇi proñchet.
analyzed: vajratārāyāḥ maṇḍale brahmakoṇa sūtreṣu eva sthiteṣu brahmataḥ bahis karṇikā tri mātrā antareṇa vṛttam sūtram ekam tad bahis dala ṣaṣ mātra antareṇa vṛtta sūtram brahmakoṇa sūtrāṇi proñchet

original: 12.5.17 Mārīcīmaṇḍala (p.199)
analyzed: R 12517 Cp maṇḍala

original: pañcaviṃśatyātmakamārīcīmaṇḍale mañjuvajramaṇḍalavaṭ ṭipiḥ.
12.5.8 Pañcarakṣāmaṇḍala (p.199)
analyzed: R Pañcarakṣā maṇḍala

original: pañcarakṣāṇāṃ trayodaśātmake maṇḍale brahmakoṇasūtrāṇy eva nānyat / tatra brahmasūtrād bahiḥ samantataś caturmātrikāntare madhyapadmaṃ tadbāhye 'ṣṭamātrāntare dikṣu catvāri padmāni brahmakoṇasūtrāṇi lumped iti viśeṣā ṭippaṇī /
analyzed: pañca rakṣāṇām trayodaśa ātmake maṇḍale brahmakoṇa sūtrāṇi eva na anyat tatra brahmasūtrāt bahis samantataḥ catur mātrikā antare madhya padmam tad bāhye ṣṭa mātrā antare dikṣu catvāri padmāni brahmakoṇa sūtrāṇi lumpet iti viśeṣāḥ ṭippaṇī

original: 12.5.19 Vajradhātumaṇḍala (p.200)
analyzed: R vajra dhātu maṇḍala

original: tripañcaśaddevatātmakavajradhātumaṇḍale mūlasūtrasyābhyantare svadvāradvayamitāntaraṃ tyaktvā tiryak sūtram ekaṃ koṇasūtradvayaṃ yāvat / tad evābhyantaradvitīyamaṇḍalasya mūlasūtraṃ dvāraniryūhādikramaśīrṣasūtraparyantayuktaṃ nistoraṇādikaṃ /
analyzed: tripañcaśat devatā ātmaka vajra dhātu maṇḍale mūla sūtrasya abhyantare sva dvāra dvaya mita antaram tyaktvā tiryak sūtram ekam koṇa sūtra dvayam yāvat tat eva abhyantara dvitīya maṇḍalasya mūla sūtram dvāra niryūha ādi krama śīrṣa sūtra paryanta yuktam nistoraṇa ādikam

original: asya mūlasūtrasyābhyantare 'nantaram eva prathamaṃ vṛttasūtraṃ tadabhyantare vajrāvalīmātrikāntareṇa dvitīyaṃ tasmād aparadigvṛttasūtraṃ yāvad brahmaṇo dakṣiṇapārśve sūtradvayaṃ prathamaṃ mātrādvayāntareṇa dvitīyaṃ stambhamātrikāntareṇa / evaṃ vāme / tato brahmakoṇasūtralopān navakoṣṭhā bhavanti /
analyzed: asya mūla sūtrasya abhyantare nantaram eva prathamam vṛtta sūtram tad abhyantare vajra āvalī mātrikā antareṇa dvitīyam tasmāt apara diś vṛtta sūtram yāvat brahmaṇaḥ dakṣiṇa pārśve sūtra dvayam prathamam mātrā dvaya antareṇa dvitīyam stambha mātrikā antareṇa evam vāme tatas brahma koṇa sūtra lopāt nava koṣṭhāḥ bhavanti

original: aparabrahmasūtrāṇi nāyakasthānapaṭyantaḥsūtrāṇi ca proñchyānīti viśeṣā ṭṭipiḥ /
analyzed: apara brahmasūtrāṇi nāyakasthāna paṭī antar sūtrāṇi ca proñchyāni iti viśeṣāḥ ṭṭipiḥ

original: garbhakūṭāgāraṃ satoraṇam iti tu trilokavijayamaṇḍalasyaivoktaṃ tattvasaṃgrahe / yad uktaṃ /
analyzed: garbha kūṭāgāram sa toraṇam iti tu triloka vijaya maṇḍalasya evā uktam tattvasaṃgrahe yat uktam

original: vajrastambhāgrasaṃstheṣu pañcamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam //
analyzed: vajra stambha agra saṃstheṣu pañca maṇḍala maṇḍitam

original: iti tat pañcatathāgatasthāneṣu vartulavajrarekhā lekhyās tāsu ca pañcacandramaṇḍalāni likhyānīti vyākhyātam ānandagarbheṇa tat tv asaṃgataṃ / na hi vartulavajrarekhāṇām vācakam idaṃ tantravākyaṃ /
analyzed: iti tat pañca tathāgata sthāneṣu vartula vajra rekhāḥ lekhyāḥ tāsu ca pañca candra maṇḍalāni likhyāni iti vyākhyātam ānandagarbheṇa tat tu asaṃgatam na hi vartula vajra rekhāṇām vācakam idam tantra vākyam

original: 12.5.20 Mañjuvajramaṇḍala (p.201)
analyzed: R Mañju vajra maṇḍala

original: tricatvāriṃśadātmakamañjuvajramaṇḍale mūlasūtrasyābhyantare dvāradvayāntareṇa tiryak sūtram ekaṃ koṇasūtradvayalagnaṃ tad evābhyantaradvitīyamaṇḍalasya mūlasūtraṃ dvāraniryūhādikramaśīrṣasūtraparyantayuktam atoraṇādikaṃ /
analyzed: tricatvāriṃśat ātmaka mañju vajra maṇḍale mūla sūtrasya abhyantare dvāra dvaya antareṇa tiryak sūtram ekam koṇa sūtra dvaya lagnam tat eva abhyantara dvitīya maṇḍalasya mūla sūtram dvāra niryūha ādi krama śīrṣa sūtra paryanta yuktam a toraṇa ādikam

original: asyābhyantare svadvāradvayāntareṇa tiryak sūtram ekaṃ koṇasūtralagnam etad eva tṛtīyagarbhamaṇḍalasya mūlasūtraṃ dvāraniryūhādiyuktam atoraṇādikaṃ / asya mūlasūtrasyābhyantare 'nantaram eva prathamam ityādinoktavajradhātugarbhamaṇḍalavat tṛtīyaṃ maṇḍalam iti viśeṣā ṭippaṇī /
analyzed: asya abhyantare sva dvāra dvaya antareṇa tiryak sūtram ekam koṇa sūtra lagnam etat eva tṛtīya garbha maṇḍalasya mūla sūtram dvāra niryūha ādi yuktam a toraṇa ādikam asya mūla sūtrasya abhyantare nantaram eva prathamam ityādinā ukta vajra dhātu garbha maṇḍala vat tṛtīyam maṇḍalam iti viśeṣāḥ ṭippaṇī

original: 12.5.21 Dharmadhātuvāgīśvaramaṇḍala (p.202)
analyzed: R

original: bhagavato dharmadhātuvāgīśvarasya maṇḍale prāguktasarvamaṇḍalasādhāraṇabahirmaṇḍalasūtraṇavidhiḥ jñeyaḥ / mūlasūtrādīni tu saptasūtrāṇi vartulānīti viśeṣaḥ / yad uktaṃ
analyzed: bhagavataḥ dharmadhātu vāgīśvarasya maṇḍale prāc ukta sarva maṇḍala sādhāraṇa bahis maṇḍala sūtraṇa vidhiḥ jñeyaḥ mūlasūtra ādīni tu sapta sūtrāṇi vartulāni iti viśeṣaḥ yat uktam

original: vartulaṃ sarvato bhadram
analyzed: vartulam sarvatas bhadram

original: ity ādikaṃ / asya niryūhalagnamūlasūtrasyābhyantare dvāradvayāntaraṃ tyaktvā tiryak sūtram ekaṃ koṇasūtradvayasaktaṃ / tad evābhyantaradvitīyamaṇḍalasya mūlasūtraṃ dvāraniryūhādikramaśīrṣasūtrāvasānaṃ yuktaṃ toraṇarahitaṃ / asya mūlasūtrasyābhyantare tathā tṛtīyamaṇḍalasya mūlasūtraṃ tathā /
analyzed: iti ādikam asya niryūha lagna mūla sūtrasya abhyantare dvāra dvaya antaram tyaktvā tiryak sūtram ekam koṇa sūtra dvaya saktam tat eva abhyantara dvitīya maṇḍalasya mūla sūtram dvāra niryūha ādi krama śīrṣa sūtra avasānam yuktam toraṇa rahitam asya mūla sūtrasya abhyantare tathā tṛtīya maṇḍalasya mūla sūtram tathā

original: asya mūlasūtrasyābhyantare svadvāradvayetyādinoktavarjradhātugarbhamaṇḍalam iva caturthamaṇḍalam iti viśeṣā ṭipiḥ /
analyzed: asya mūla sūtrasya abhyantare sva dvāra dvaya ityādinā ukta varjra dhātu garbha maṇḍalam iva caturtha maṇḍalam iti viśeṣā ṭipiḥ

original: 12.5.22 Durgatipariśodhanamaṇḍala (p.203)
analyzed: R Durgati pariśodhana maṇḍala

original: durgatipariśodhanamaṇḍale piṇḍīkramoktamaṇḍalavaṭ ṭipiḥ / kiṃ tu vajrāvalyā abhyantaram aṣṭastambhādirahitaṃ pītāṣṭāracakreṇaiva maṇḍitam iti viśeṣaḥ /
analyzed: durgati pariśodhana maṇḍale piṇḍī krama ukta maṇḍala vat ṭipiḥ kim tu vajrāvalyāḥ abhyantaram aṣṭa stambha ādi rahitam pīta aṣṭa āra cakreṇa eva maṇḍitam iti viśeṣaḥ

original: 12.5.23 Bhūtaḍāmaramaṇḍala (p.203)
analyzed: R bhūta ḍāmara maṇḍala

original: bhagavato bhūtaḍāmarasya maṇḍale caturasramūlasūtrasyābhyantare caturmātrāntaraṃ tyaktvā tiryak sūtratrayaṃ koṇasūtradvayalagnaṃ / tasyābhyantare caturmātrāntareṇaikaṃ tiryak sūtraṃ tathā / tasyābhyantare caturmātrāntareṇa mañjuvajramaṇḍaloktagarbhapuṭam iva garbhapuṭam iti catuṣpuṭaṭipitaṃ /
analyzed: bhagavataḥ bhūtaḍāmarasya maṇḍale catur asra mūla sūtrasya abhyantare catur mātra antaram tyaktvā tiryak sūtra trayam koṇa sūtra dvaya lagnam tasya abhyantare catur mātra antareṇa ekam tiryak sūtram tathā tasya abhyantare catur mātra antareṇa mañju vajra maṇḍala ukta garbhapuṭam iva garbhapuṭam iti catuṣpuṭa ṭipitam

original: 12.5.24 Pañcaḍākamaṇḍala (p.204)
analyzed: R Pañcaḍāka maṇḍala

original: pañcaḍākamaṇḍale mahāmaṇḍalasya mātrāmānena mūlasūtrābhyantare sārdhaikamātrikam antaraṃ parityajyāparanavamātrikam antaraṃ dvādaśasamāṃśān kṛtvā pratipārśvam aṃśadvayaṃ tyaktvā madhyāṣṭamāṃśamānaṃ mūlasūtracatuṣṭayaṃ tad ekasyāṣṭamāṃśo dvāraṃ mūlasūtrād bahiḥ ṣaṭsūtrāṇītyādikaṃ ca prāgvad vidhātavyaṃ /
analyzed: pañcaḍāka maṇḍale mahā maṇḍalasya mātrā mānena mūla sūtra abhyantare sārdha eka mātrikam antaram parityajya apara nava mātrikam antaram dvādaśa sama aṃśān kṛtvā pratipārśvam aṃśa dvayam tyaktvā madhya aṣṭama aṃśa mānam mūla sūtra catuṣṭayam tat ekasya aṣṭama aṃśaḥ dvāram mūla sūtrāt bahis ṣaṣ sūtrāṇi iti ādikam ca prāgvat vidhātavyam

original: evaṃ catvāri kūṭāgārāṇi nistoraṇāni dikṣu nābhau tu pañcamaṃ kūṭāgāraṃ tadvat / navamātrikam ityādikaṃ hy atrāpi jñātavyaṃ / kiṃ tv asya kūṭāgārasya caturṇāṃ cāntaraṃ mahāmaṇḍalamātrayaikamātrikaṃ /
analyzed: evam catvāri kūṭāgārāṇi nistoraṇāni dikṣu nābhau tu pañcamam kūṭāgāram tadvat nava mātrikam iti ādikam hi atra api jñātavyam kim tu asya kūṭāgārasya caturṇām ca antaram mahā maṇḍala mātrayā eka mātrikam

original: bāhyavajrakulamaṇḍale padmeṣu pūrvādidikṣv indra-yama-varuṇa-kuberāṇāṃ vajraṃ kṛṣṇadaṇḍo nāgapāśo 'ṅkuśaḥ / aiśānyādividikṣv īśāna-agni-nairṛti-vāyūnāṃ triśūlaṃ śruvaḥ khaḍgaḥ vātapaṭaḥ /
analyzed: bāhya vajra kula maṇḍale padmeṣu pūrva ādi dikṣu indra yama varuṇa kuberāṇām vajram kṛṣṇa daṇḍaḥ nāgapāśaḥ ṅkuśaḥ aiśānī ādi vidikṣu īśāna agni nairṛti vāyūnām triśūlam śruvaḥ khaḍgaḥ vātapaṭaḥ

original: tata īśānasya bahiḥ samīpe aiśānīṃ diśam ārabhya cihnāni kramato likhyāni / tatra brahmaṇo 'kṣasūtraṃ viṣṇoś cakraṃ / maheśvarasya triśūlaṃ / kārtikeyasya śaktiḥ /
analyzed: tatas īśānasya bahis samīpe aiśānīm diśam ārabhya cihnāni kramatas likhyāni tatra kṣa sūtram viṣṇoḥ cakram maheśvarasya triśūlam kārtikeyasya śaktiḥ

original: brahmāṇyā akṣasūtraṃ / rudrāṇyās triśūlaṃ / vaiṣṇavyāś cakraṃ / kaumāryāḥ śaktiḥ / indrāṇyā vajraṃ / vārāhyā rohitamatsyaḥ / cāmuṇḍāyāḥ karttiḥ / bhṛṅgiṇo 'kṣamālā / gaṇapateḥ parśuḥ / mahākālasya triśūlaṃ / nandikeśvarasya murajaḥ /
analyzed: brahmāṇyāḥ akṣa sūtram rudrāṇyāḥ triśūlam vaiṣṇavyāḥ cakram kaumāryāḥ śaktiḥ indrāṇyāḥ vajram vārāhyāḥ rohita matsyaḥ cāmuṇḍāyāḥ karttiḥ bhṛṅgiṇaḥ kṣamālā gaṇapateḥ parśuḥ mahākālasya triśūlam nandikeśvarasya murajaḥ

original: ādityasya padmasthasūryamaṇḍalaṃ / candrasya kumudasthacandramaṇḍalaṃ / maṅgalasya kaṭṭāraḥ / budhasya bāṇaḥ / bṛhaspater akṣasūtraṃ / śukrasyākṣasūtraṃ / śanaiścarasya kṛṣṇadaṇḍaḥ / rāhoś candraḥ / ketor nāgapāśaḥ / balabhadrasya lāṅgalaṃ / jayakarasya puṣpamālā / madhukarasya makaradhvajaḥ / vasantasya bāṇaḥ /
analyzed: ādityasya padma stha sūrya maṇḍalam candrasya kumuda stha candra maṇḍalam maṅgalasya kaṭṭāraḥ budhasya bāṇaḥ bṛhaspateḥ akṣa sūtram śukrasya akṣa sūtram śanaiścarasya kṛṣṇa daṇḍaḥ rāhoḥ candraḥ ketoḥ nāgapāśaḥ balabhadrasya lāṅgalam jaya karasya puṣpa mālā madhukarasya makaradhvajaḥ vasantasya bāṇaḥ

original: ananta-vāsuki-takṣaka-karkkoṭaka-padma-mahāpadma-śaṅkhapāla-kulikānām api sampuṭāñjaliḥ / athavā svasvapitṛcihnasadṛśaṃ cihnaṃ/ tatrānanta-kulikau brāhmaṇāv agneḥ putrau / vāsuki-śaṅkhapālau kṣatriyāv indrasya / takṣaka-mahāpadmau vaiśyau vāyoḥ / karkkoṭaka-padmau śūdrau varaṇasya /
analyzed: ananta vāsuki takṣaka karkkoṭaka padma mahāpadma śaṅkhapāla kulikānām api sampuṭa añjaliḥ athavā sva sva pitṛ cihna sadṛśam cihnam tatra ananta kulikau brāhmaṇau agneḥ putrau vāsuki śaṅkhapālau kṣatriyau indrasya takṣaka mahāpadmau vaiśyau vāyoḥ karkkoṭaka padmau śūdrau varaṇasya

original: vemacitri-bali-prahlāda-vairocanādimahāsurendrāṇāṃ khaḍgādinānāpraharaṇāni / garuḍendrasya sampuṭāñjaliḥ / drumasya kinnararājendrasya vīṇā / pañcaśikhasya gandharvarājendrasya vīṇā / sarvārthasiddhasya vidyādhararājendrasya kusumamālā / pūrṇabhadra-māṇibhadra-dhanada-vaiśravaṇa-civikuṇḍali-kelimāli-mukhendra-carendrāṇāṃ yakṣāṇāṃ bījapūraphalāni /
analyzed: vema citri bali prahlāda vairocana ādi mahā asura indrāṇām khaḍga ādi nānā praharaṇāni garuḍa indrasya sampuṭa añjaliḥ drumasya kinnara rāja indrasya vīṇā pañcaśikhasya gandharva rāja indrasya vīṇā sarvārthasiddhasya vidyādhara rāja indrasya kusuma mālā pūrṇabhadra māṇi bhadra dhanada vaiśravaṇa civi kuṇḍali kelimāli mukha indra cara indrāṇām yakṣāṇām bījapūra phalāni

original: hārītyā jaḍīdvayaṃ /

aśvinī-bharaṇī-kṛttikā-rohiṇī-mṛgaśirā-ārdrā-punarvasu-puṣyā-aśleṣā-maghā-pūrvaphālgunī-uttaraphālgunī-hastā-citrā-svātī-viśākhā-anurādhā-jyeṣṭhā-mūlā-pūrvāṣādhā-uttarāṣādhā-śravaṇā-dhaniṣṭhā-śatabhiṣā-pūrvabhādrapadā-uttarabhādrapadā-revatī-abhijīnāṃ samputāñjalikaramudrāḥ /
analyzed: aśvinī bharaṇī kṛttikā rohiṇī mṛgaśirāḥ ārdrā punarvasu puṣyā aśleṣā maghā pūrva phālgunī uttara phālgunī hastā citrā svāti viśākhā anurādhā jyeṣṭhā mūlā pūrvāṣādhā uttarāṣādhā śravaṇā dhaniṣṭhā śatabhiṣā pūrvabhādrapadā uttarabhādrapada revatī abhijīnām samputa añjali kara mudrāḥ

original: atrāpi dvāreṣu vajrāṅkuśādīni / kalaśāś caturthamaṇḍale /
analyzed: atra api dvāreṣu vajra aṅkuśa ādīni kalaśāḥ caturtha maṇḍale

original: 13.3.22 Durgatipariśodhanamaṇḍala (p.288)
analyzed: R Durgati pariśodhana maṇḍala

original: durgatipariśodhanamaṇḍale nīlavajrāvalyā abhyantare pītāṣṭāracakrasya vedyāṃ pītadharmacakramudrā /
analyzed: durgati pariśodhana maṇḍale nīla vajrāvalyāḥ abhyantare pīta aṣṭa āra cakrasya vedyām pīta dharmacakra mudrā

original: pūrvādyareṣu śubhrabhūsparśamudrānīlavaradamudrāraktadhyānamudrāharitābhayamudrāḥ / agnyādyareṣu sūryaś cintāmaṇidhvajo 'siś chattraṃ /
analyzed: pūrva ādi areṣu śubhra bhūsparśa mudrā nīla varada mudrā rakta dhyāna mudrā harita abhaya mudrāḥ agni ādi areṣu sūryaḥ chattram

original: vajrāvalīto bahir vahnyādikoṇeṣu lāsyādicihnāni pūrvādipaṭṭīṣu dvārasya vāme cihnadvayaṃ savye ca / tatra nāgakeśarakusumaṃ sanetrābjam aṅkuśo daṇḍaḥ śaṅkhaṃ khaḍgaḥ / padmasthadharmagañjaś cintāmaṇidhvajo 'mṛtakalaśaḥ padmasthacandrabimbaṃ ratnaṃ vajrapañrajaṃ savajrendīvaram amṛtaghaṭo 'bjastharatnaṃ ratnamañjarī ca /
analyzed: vajra āvalītaḥ bahis vahni ādi koṇeṣu lāsya ādi cihnāni pūrva ādi paṭṭīṣu dvārasya vāme cihna dvayam savye ca tatra nāgakeśara kusumam sanetrābjam aṅkuśaḥ daṇḍaḥ śaṅkham khaḍgaḥ padma stha dharmagañjaḥ cintāmaṇi dhvajaḥ mṛta kalaśaḥ padma stha candra bimbam ratnam vajrapañrajam sa vajra indīvaram amṛtaghaṭaḥ bja stha ratnam ratnamañjarī ca

original: agnyādikoṇeṣu puṣpādicihnāni / dvāreṣu vajrāṅkuśādīni /
analyzed: agni ādi koṇeṣu puṣpa ādi cihnāni dvāreṣu vajra aṅkuśa ādīni

original: saptatriṃśad api cihnāni viśvābjacandrasthāni / nīlakaṇṭhādicihnāni na likhyante 'pi /
analyzed: saptatriṃśat api cihnāni viśva abja candra sthāni nīlakaṇṭha ādi cihnāni na likhyante

original: 13.3.23 Bhūtaḍāmaramaṇḍala (p.290)
analyzed: bhūta ḍāmara maṇḍala

original: bhūtaḍāmaramaṇḍale sitapītaraktaharitakṛṣṇāḥ pañcabhittayaḥ pūrvādibhūmayaś ca / sūtrarekhātrayaṃ śvetaraktakṛṣṇavarṇā ekasūtrarekhā kṛṣṇā vajravalayarekhe ca / garbhapuṭasya madhye koṣṭhe viśvapadmacandre bhagavato bhūtaḍāmarasya pañcaśūlanīlavajraṃ /
analyzed: bhūta ḍāmara maṇḍale sita pīta rakta harita kṛṣṇāḥ pañca bhittayaḥ pūrva ādi bhūmayaḥ ca sūtra rekhā trayam śveta rakta kṛṣṇa varṇā eka sūtra rekhā kṛṣṇā vajra valaya rekhe ca garbhapuṭasya madhye koṣṭhe viśva padma candre bhagavataḥ bhūta ḍāmarasya pañcaśūla nīla vajram

original: pūrve maheśvarasya sūrye triśūlaṃ / dakṣiṇe viṣṇoḥ sūrye cakraṃ / paścime brahmaṇaś candre 'kṣamālā / uttare kārtikeyasya sūrye śaktiḥ / aiśāne gaṇapateś candre parśuḥ / āgneye rave ravau padmasthasūryamaṇḍalaṃ / nairṛte rāhoḥ sūrye candramaṇḍalaṃ / vāyave nandikeśvarasya candre ḍamaruḥ /
analyzed: pūrve maheśvarasya sūrye triśūlam dakṣiṇe viṣṇoḥ sūrye cakram paścime brahmaṇaḥ candre kṣamālā uttare kārtikeyasya sūrye śaktiḥ aiśāne gaṇapateḥ candre parśuḥ āgneye raveḥ ravau padma stha sūrya maṇḍalam nairṛte rāhoḥ sūrye candra maṇḍalam vāyave nandikeśvarasya candre ḍamaruḥ

original: dvitīyapuṭe purvādidikṣu śrītilottamā-śaśī-umānāṃ candreṣu śvetābjaṃ dhūpakaṭacchuḥ dīpayaṣṭir bhogākārakaraḥ / āgneyyādiṣu ratnaśrī-sarasvatī-surasundarī-ābhūtīnāṃ yathākramaṃ candreṣu gandhaśaṅkhaṃ vīṇā ratnamamālā triśūkavajraṃ /
analyzed: dvitīya puṭe purva ādi dikṣu śrī tilottamā śaśī umānām candreṣu śveta abjam dhūpa kaṭacchuḥ dīpa yaṣṭiḥ bhoga ākāra karaḥ āgneyī ādiṣu ratna śrī sarasvatī surasundarī ābhūtīnām yathākramam candreṣu gandhaśaṅkham vīṇā ratnam amālā triśūka vajram

original: tṛtīyapuṭe pūrvādidikṣv indra-yama-varuṇa-kuberāṇāṃ candrasthavajraṃ sūryasthakapālāṅkitadaṇḍaś candrasthanāgapāśaś candrasthagadā / āgneyādividikṣv agini-nairṛti-vāyu-candrāṇāṃ sūraysthākṣasūtraṃ sūryasthakhaḍgaś candrasthavātapaṭaś candre kumudasthacandramaṇḍalaṃ / candracihnasamīpe īśānasya sūrye triṣūlaṃ /
analyzed: tṛtīya puṭe pūrva ādi dikṣu indra yama varuṇa kuberāṇām candra stha vajram sūrya stha kapāla aṅkita daṇḍaḥ candra stha nāgapāśaḥ candra stha gadāḥ āgneya ādi vidikṣu agini nairṛti vāyu candrāṇām sūrya stha akṣa sūtram sūrya stha khaḍgaḥ candra stha vātapaṭaḥ candre kumuda stha candra maṇḍalam candra cihna samīpe īśānasya sūrye triṣūlam

original: caturthapuṭe purvādidikṣu siṃhadhvajadhāriṇī-vibhūtī-mahāpadmavatī-surahāriṇīnāṃ candreṣu siṃhadhvajo 'ṅkuśo bāṇaś cintāmaṇiḥ / aiśānyādiṣu varahārī-ratneśvarī-bhūṣaṇī-jagatpālanīnāṃ candreṣu puṣpapuṭo dhūpakaṭacchur gandhaśaṅkho dīpayaṣṭiḥ /
analyzed: caturtha puṭe purva ādi dikṣu siṃhadhvaja dhāriṇī vibhūtī mahāpadmavatī surahāriṇīnām candreṣu siṃhadhvajaḥ ṅkuśaḥ bāṇaḥ cintāmaṇiḥ aiśānī ādiṣu varahārī ratneśvarī bhūṣaṇī jagatpālanīnām candreṣu puṣpapuṭaḥ dhūpa kaṭacchuḥ gandhaśaṅkhaḥ dīpayaṣṭiḥ

original: atra sarva ravīndavo viśvapadmasthāḥ / kalaśāś caturthapuṭe /
analyzed: atra ravi indavaḥ viśva padma sthāḥ kalaśāḥ caturtha puṭe

original: 13.3.24 Pañcaḍākamaṇḍala (p.292)
analyzed: R Pañcaḍāka maṇḍala

original: pañcaḍākamaṇḍale madhyakūṭāgarasya madhye saprajñāhevajrasya karttikapālau / pūrvādivāreṣu gaurī-caurī-vettālī-ghasmarīṇāṃ vajrāṅkuśapāśasphoṭaghaṇṭāḥ / aiśānādikoṇeṣu pukkasī-śabarī-caṇḍālī-ḍombīnāṃ bodhicittaghaṭo merur bahnikuṇḍaṃ mahādhvajapatākā /
analyzed: pañcaḍāka maṇḍale madhya kūṭa āgarasya madhye saprajñā hevajrasya kartti kapālau pūrva ādi vāreṣu gaurī caurī vettālī ghasmarīṇām vajra aṅkuśa pāśa sphoṭa ghaṇṭāḥ aiśāna ādi koṇeṣu pukkasī śabarī caṇḍālī ḍombīnām bodhi citta ghaṭaḥ meruḥ bahnikuṇḍam mahā dhvajapatākā

original: tasmāt pūrvakūṭāgārasya madhye śāśvatasya kapālasthamayūraḥ / pūrvādidvāreṣu saṃdaṃśā-pāśnī-vāgurā-aṅkuśadhāriṇīnāṃ saṃdaṃśaḥ pāśo vāgurāṅkuśaḥ / aiśānādiṣu puṣpā-dhūpā-dīpā-gandhānāṃ puṣpakaraṇḍo dhūpakaṭacchur dīpayaṣṭiḥ pītagandhapūrṇaśaṅkhaḥ /
analyzed: tasmāt pūrva kūṭāgārasya madhye śāśvatasya kapāla stha mayūraḥ pūrva ādi dvāreṣu saṃdaṃśa apāśnī vāgurā aṅkuśa dhāriṇīnām saṃdaṃśaḥ pāśaḥ vāgurā aṅkuśaḥ aiśāna ādiṣu puṣpa ādhūpa ādīpa agandhānām puṣpa karaṇḍaḥ dhūpa kaṭacchuḥ dīpa yaṣṭiḥ pīta gandha pūrṇa śaṅkhaḥ

original: dakṣiṇakūṭāgārasya madhye vajrasūryasya kapālasthakāraṇḍavaḥ pakṣī / pūrvādidvāreṣu sūryahastā-dīpā-ratnolkā-taḍitkarāṇāṃ sūryamaṇḍalaṃ dīpayaṣṭhī ratnaṃ vidyullatā / aiśānādiṣu lāsyā-mālā-gītā-nṛtyānāṃ vajraṃ ratnamālā kaṃsikā vajraṃ / pścimakūṭāgarasya madhye padmanarteśvarasya kapālasthabhallūkaḥ /
analyzed: dakṣiṇa kūṭāgārasya madhye vajra sūryasya kapāla stha kāraṇḍavaḥ pakṣī pūrva ādi dvāreṣu sūrya hastā dīpa aratna ulkā taḍitkarāṇām sūrya maṇḍalam dīpa yaṣṭhī ratnam vidyut latā aiśāna ādiṣu lāsyā mālā gītā nṛtyānām vajram ratnamālā kaṃsikā vajram pūcima kūṭāgarasya madhye padmanarta īśvarasya kapāla stha bhallūkaḥ

original: prāgādidvāreṣu padmā-dharmodayā-sphoṭā-svāśleṣāṇāṃ padmaṃ dharmodayā sphoṭo vajraṃ / aiśānādiṣu vaṃśā-vīṇā-mukundā-murajānāṃ svasvavādyāni /
analyzed: prāc ādi dvāreṣu padma adharma udaya āsphoṭa āsu āśleṣāṇām padmam dharma udayā sphoṭaḥ vajram aiśāna ādiṣu vaṃśa vīṇā mukundā murajānām sva sva vādyāni

original: uttaramaṇḍalasya madhye paramāśvasya kapālasthabudhaḥ / prāgādidvāreṣu tālā-kuñcī-kapāṭā-paṭadhāriṇīnāṃ tālikā kuñcikā kapāṭaṃ kāṇḍapaṭaḥ / aiśānādiṣu locanā-māmakī-pāṇḍarā-tārānāṃ cakraṃ vajraṃ padmaṃ utpalaṃ /
analyzed: uttara maṇḍalasya madhye parama aśvasya kapāla stha budhaḥ prāc ādi dvāreṣu tālā kuñcī kapāṭā paṭa dhāriṇīnām tālikā kuñcikā kapāṭam kāṇḍapaṭaḥ aiśāna ādiṣu locanā māmakī pāṇḍarā tārānām cakram vajram padmam utpalam

original: bāhyamahāmaṇḍalasya dvāreṣu gauryādicihnāni / aiśānādiṣu pukkasyādicihnāni /
analyzed: bāhya mahā maṇḍalasya dvāreṣu gaurī ādi cihnāni aiśāna ādiṣu pukkasī ādi cihnāni

original: etāni sarvacihnāni viśvapadmasūryasthāni / śāśvatasyaiva candrāsanasthaṃ / pratimaṇḍalam amṛtakalaśāḥ / mahāmaṇḍala eveti kaścit /
analyzed: etāni sarva cihnāni viśva padma sūrya sthāni śāśvatasya eva candrāsana stham pratimaṇḍalam amṛta kalaśāḥ mahā maṇḍale eva iti kaścid

original: 13.3.25 Ṣaṭcakravartimaṇḍala (p.295)
analyzed: śrī adhika

original: ṣaṭcakravartimaṇḍale viśvapadmeṣu sūryasthāni cihnāni buddhaḍākasya paraṃ candrasthaṃ / ṣaṇṇām api kūṭāgārāṇāṃ koṇeṣu kapālāni viśvapadmasthāni /
analyzed: ṣaṣ cakravarti maṇḍale viśva padmeṣu sūrya sthāni cihnāni buddha ḍākasya param candra stham ṣaṇṇām api kūṭāgārāṇām koṇeṣu kapālāni viśva padma sthāni

original: tatra garbhamaṇḍalasya madhye padme vajrasattvasya vajraṃ / vidikpadmeṣu ḍākinī-lāmā-khaṇḍarohā-rūpiṇīnāṃ ḍamaravaḥ / prāgādidvāreṣu vāmāvartenāgnyādividikṣu dakṣiṇāvartenetīha nyāsakramaḥ / dvārābjeṣu khaṇḍakapāla-pracaṇḍayor mahākaṅkāla-caṇḍākṣyoḥ kaṅkāla-prabhāvatyor vikaṭadaṃṣṭri-mahānāsayoś catvāri vajrāṇi / valayamadhye vajrāvalī /
analyzed: tatra garbha maṇḍalasya madhye padme vajra sattvasya vajram vidiś padmeṣu ḍākinī lāmā khaṇḍa rohā rūpiṇīnām ḍamaravaḥ prāc ādi dvāreṣu vāma āvartena agni ādi vidikṣu dakṣiṇa āvartena iti iha nyāsa kramaḥ dvāra abjeṣu khaṇḍa kapāla pracaṇḍayoḥ mahākaṅkāla caṇḍākṣyoḥ kaṅkāla prabhāvatyoḥ vikaṭa daṃṣṭri mahānāsayoḥ catvāri vajrāṇi valaya madhye vajra āvalī

original: buddhaḍākasya maṇḍale madhyābje cakraṃ / dvārābjeṣu surāvairi-vīramatyor amitābha-kharvaryor vajraprabha-laṅkeśvaryor vajradeha-drumacchāyayoś ca cakrāṇi / valayamadhye cakrāvalī /
analyzed: buddha ḍākasya maṇḍale madhya abje cakram dvāra abjeṣu surā vairi vīramatyoḥ amitābha kharvaryoḥ vajraprabha laṅkā īśvaryoḥ vajra deha druma chāyayoḥ ca cakrāṇi valaya madhye cakra āvalī

original: iha vajrasya madhyapūrvādisūkeṣu varaṭakaparyanteṣv akṣobhyavairocanādīn dhyāyāt / athavā madhye vairocanaṃ pūrvādidaleṣu maitreya-kṣitigarbha-vajrapāṇi-gaganagañja-lokeśvara-mañjuśrī-sarvanivaraṇaviṣkambhi-samantabhadrān / aṣṭāṃśe vajrasattvaṃ / aparapadme pūrvādidaleṣu vajrāṅkuśī-vajrapāśī-vajrasphoṭā-vajrāveśāḥ /
analyzed: iha vajrasya madhya pūrva ādi sūkeṣu varaṭaka paryanteṣu akṣobhya vairocana ādīn dhyāyāt athavā madhye vairocanam pūrva ādi daleṣu maitreya kṣitigarbha vajrapāṇi gagana gañja lokeśvara mañjuśrī sarva nivaraṇa viṣkambhi samantabhadrān aṣṭa aṃśe vajra sattvam apara padme pūrva ādi daleṣu vajrāṅkuśī vajrapāśī vajrasphoṭā vajra āveśāḥ

original: āgneyyādiṣu cundā-ratnolkā-vajraśṛṅkhalā-'parājitāḥ / aparāntasūkeṣu madhye jñānaḍākinīṃ pūrve vajraḍākinīm uttare ghoraḍākinīṃ paścime vetālīṃ dakṣiṇe caṇḍālīṃ /
analyzed: āgneyī ādiṣu cundā ratna ulkā vajraśṛṅkhalā parājitāḥ apara anta sūkeṣu madhye jñāna ḍākinīm pūrve vajra ḍākinīm uttare ghora ḍākinīm paścime vetālīm dakṣiṇe caṇḍālīm

original: ghaṇṭopary adhomukhapadmadaleṣu dikṣu dakṣiṇāvarttena locanā-māmakī-pāṇḍarā-tārāḥ vidikṣu vasudhārā-cundā-bhṛkuṭī-vajramālāḥ / kumbhasya madhye prajñā-pāramitāyāḥ śarīram upari mukhaṃ / tadupari padmaṃ vajraṃ ca pūrvavat /
analyzed: ghaṇṭā upari adhomukha padma daleṣu dikṣu dakṣiṇa āvarttena locanā māmakī pāṇḍarā tārāḥ vidikṣu vasudhārā cundā bhṛkuṭī vajra mālāḥ kumbhasya madhye prajñāpāramitāyāḥ śarīram upari mukham tad upari padmam vajram ca pūrvavat

original: āsāṃ cākṣobhyādidevatānāṃ bījacihnabhujādikaṃ niṣpannayogāvalyām uktaṃ /
analyzed: āsām ca akṣobhya ādi devatānām bīja cihna bhuja ādikam niṣpanna yogāvalyām uktam

original: tataḥ samayasattvadevatā niṣpādya hṛdbījaraśminā jñānadevatā ānīya pādyādipuraḥsaraṃ tāsu praveṣya vidhivat pratiṣṭhāpya pūjādikaṃ kṛtvā devatāḥ pariṇamya śūkādirūpeṇa sthitā vajram upāyasvabhāvaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ tu prajñātmikām ubhayam api pāramārthikabodhicittasvarūpam iti sudṛḍham adhimucya oṃ sarvatathāgata siddhi vajrasamaye tiṣṭha eṣa tvāṃ dhārayāmi
analyzed: tatas samaya sattva devatāḥ niṣpādya hṛd bīja raśminā jñānadevatāḥ ānīya pādya ādi puraḥsaram tāsu praveṣya vidhivat pratiṣṭhāpya pūjā ādikam kṛtvā devatāḥ pariṇamya śūka ādi rūpeṇa sthitāḥ vajram upāya svabhāvam ghaṇṭām tu prajñā ātmikām ubhayam api pāramārthika bodhi citta svarūpam iti su dṛḍham adhimucya om sarva tathāgata siddhi vajra samaye tiṣṭha eṣa tvām dhārayāmi

original: hiḥ hi hi hi hi hi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā / iti paṭhan vajraṃ svyābhyāṃ vṛddhānāmikābhyāṃ / oṃ vajraghaṇṭā hūṃ / iti paṭhan ghaṇṭāṃ ca vāmābhyāṃ dhṛtvā tāṃ vāmakaṭyāṃ nyasya vajrasattvādīn rañjayāmīty adhimuñcan hūṃ-kāroccāraṇapūrvakaṃ / soha i vajjam ullālutāri asattva vimokkha dhamma vimokkhye vajja tuṅga vajjaṅ gacchā adharantu /
analyzed: hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūm hūm hūm phaṭ svāhā iti paṭhan vajram svyābhyām vṛddha anāmikābhyām om vajraghaṇṭā hūm iti paṭhan ghaṇṭām ca vāmābhyām dhṛtvā tām vāma kaṭyām nyasya vajra sattva ādīn rañjayāmi iti adhimuñcan hūṃkāra uccāraṇa pūrvakam vajjam asattva vimokkha dhamma vimokkhye vajja tuṅga vajjam gaccha adharantu

original: hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho / iti paṭhan vajram ullālayet /
analyzed: hūm hūm hūm ho ho ho iti paṭhan vajram ullālayet

original: tato vajraṃ dakṣiṇakaṭyām avasthāpyollālayan vā / oṃ vajradharma raṇita praraṇita sampraraṇita sarvabuddhakṣetrapracāline prajñāpāramitānādasvabhāve vajrasattvahṛdayasaṃtoṣaṇi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho svāhā / iti paṭhan ghaṇṭāmadhyāṣṭadeśeṣu daṇḍaṃ cālayan vādayet / iti /

original: savistaraṃ tu ghaṇṭāvajraprabhedānāṃ lakṣaṇādikam āmnāyamañjaryām abhihitam iti vajravajraghaṇṭālakṣaṇādividhiḥ /
